+        {
+          "id": "trigger.python.python-services",
+          "when": "Structuring a Python command-line tool, HTTP backend, or worker around shared application services: its entry points, configuration, retries, cancellation, or durable work."
+        }
+      ]
+    },
+    {
+      "skill": "typer",
+      "triggers": [
+        {
+          "id": "trigger.python.typer",
+          "when": "Only when the repository's command-line interface already uses Typer: adding or changing its commands, options, or their tests."
+        }
+      ]
+    },
+    {
+      "skill": "fastapi",
+      "triggers": [
+        {
+          "id": "trigger.python.fastapi",
+          "when": "Only when the repository's HTTP service already uses FastAPI: adding or changing its routes, dependencies, Pydantic models, or their tests."
+        }
+      ]
+    },
+    {
+      "skill": "python-file-pipelines",
+      "triggers": [
+        {
+          "id": "trigger.python.python-file-pipelines",
+          "when": "Only when the repository ingests or reconciles files or generates reports in a Python pipeline, such as CSV, XML, ZIP, SQLite, XLSX, or DOCX processing."
+        }
+      ]
+    },
+    {
+      "skill": "developing-with-streamlit",
+      "triggers": [
+        {
+          "id": "trigger.python.developing-with-streamlit",
+          "when": "Only when the repository ships a Streamlit internal tool or prototype the maintainer asked for: creating or changing that Streamlit app."
+        }
+      ]
+    }
+  ],
+  "requiredDecisions": [
+
+  ],
+  "rootBlocks": [
+    {
+      "id": "root.python",
+      "version": 1,
+      "template": "template.root.python",
+      "rules": [
+
+      ],
+      "references": [
+        {
+          "id": "reference.root.python",
+          "token": "reference.python",
+          "ownership": "setup",
+          "managedId": "guide.python"
+        }
+      ]
+    }
+  ],
+  "supportingGuides": [
+    {
+      "id": "guide.python",
+      "version": 1,
+      "path": "docs/agents/python.md",
+      "template": "template.guide.python",
+      "rules": [
+        "rule.python.uv-environment",
+        "rule.python.verification-gates",
+        "rule.python.hermetic-tests"
+      ],
+      "references": [
+
+      ]
+    }
+  ],
+  "repositoryExtensions": [
+
+  ],
+  "rules": [
+    {
+      "id": "rule.python.uv-environment",
+      "version": 1,
+      "coverage": [
+        "coverage.python",
+        "coverage.dependencies"
+      ],
+      "clauses": [
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.change-dependencies-through-uv",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "Change dependencies only through uv: `uv add`, `uv add --group dev`, `uv remove` and `uv lock --upgrade-package`. Commit `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock` together, and never install into the project environment with `pip`."
+        },
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.run-tools-through-uv",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "Run Python, pytest, ruff and every other project tool through `uv run`, so each uses the locked project environment and the Python version the project pins, never a globally installed interpreter or tool."
+        },
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.sync-the-locked-environment",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "Create a worktree's or CI job's environment with `uv sync --frozen` and the development group the gate needs, so it installs exactly what `uv.lock` records; a step that must also refuse a lockfile that no longer matches `pyproject.toml` uses `--locked` instead."
+        },
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.check-the-lock-offline",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "The repository Verification checks the lockfile with `uv lock --check --offline`: it compares `uv.lock` with `pyproject.toml` from local files alone, fails when they no longer match, and needs no network or cache, so it runs inside a Run as in CI."
+        }
+      ]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "rule.python.verification-gates",
+      "version": 1,
+      "coverage": [
+        "coverage.python",
+        "coverage.verification-integrity"
+      ],
+      "clauses": [
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.iterate-with-focused-commands",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "Use focused commands such as `uv run pytest <node id>`, `uv run ruff check <path>` and `uv run ty check <path>` while iterating, then run the selected repository Verification."
+        },
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.ruff-findings-fail-the-gate",
+          "enforcement": "prohibited",
+          "guidance": "Do not hide a ruff finding: never pass `--exit-zero`, add a blanket `# noqa`, or widen the ruff configuration to make a finding disappear. A `# noqa` names the rule code it silences and the reason."
+        },
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.type-check-with-ty",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "The repository Verification type-checks the package and its tests with `uv run ty check --error-on-warning`, ty being a development dependency. Do not hide a ty diagnostic: never pass `--exit-zero` or `--exit-zero-on-warning`, add a blanket `# ty: ignore` or `# type: ignore`, or widen the ty configuration to make a diagnostic disappear. A suppression names the rule it silences and the reason."
+        },
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.select-a-new-test-by-its-node-id",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "A Task Verification selects a new test by its pytest node id, such as `tests/test_report.py::test_totals`, and never passes that test's file or directory in the same command. pytest collects a node id once when another argument already contains it and exits 0 even before the test exists, so the command could never fail before the work; a missing node id alone exits 4 and an empty selection exits 5. `roundfix spec check` reports a command that names a test both ways."
+        }
+      ]
+    },
+    {
+      "id": "rule.python.hermetic-tests",
+      "version": 1,
+      "coverage": [
+        "coverage.python",
+        "coverage.verification"
+      ],
+      "clauses": [
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.keep-tests-hermetic",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "Keep tests hermetic: set or clear with `monkeypatch` every environment variable the code under test reads, write only under `tmp_path`, and never read the host's credentials, home directory, network or tool state."
+        },
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.outside-data-skips-by-name",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "A test that needs data from outside the repository, such as a mounted drive or a credentialed service, calls `pytest.skip` with a reason that names the environment variable or path it lacks, so the selected Verification passes on a machine without that data. A Task Verification never depends on such a test."
+        },
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.exercise-every-platform-branch",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "When a change touches code that branches on the operating system, such as on `sys.platform`, `os.name` or `platform.system()`, exercise every branch it names: test each one with `monkeypatch` over the value the code reads, or run `uv run ty check --python-platform <platform>` for each platform it names, because a test run on the host executes only the host's branch."
+        },
+        {
+          "id": "clause.python.keep-entry-points-thin",
+          "enforcement": "mandatory",
+          "guidance": "Keep each entry point thin, whether a console script, a web application factory or a worker's start-up: it reads its input and calls behavior that lives in the package. Test behavior through the package and the entry point's observable contract: for a console script, standard output, standard error and the exit code it raises with `SystemExit`; for a web application or a worker, the responses or messages it produces."
+        }
+      ]
+    }
+  ]
+}

diff --git a/internal/baseline/python_profile_test.go b/internal/baseline/python_profile_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..85d440cc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/baseline/python_profile_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+// Suite: Python profile composition and skill dispatch
+// Invariant: Python guidance governs its toolchain with force and conditionally dispatches only chosen application tools.
+// Boundary IN: embedded module dispatch and greenfield plan postimages for a temporary adopter.
+// Boundary OUT: Python tool execution, skill installation, and Daemon Verification.
+
+package baseline
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"slices"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+func TestThePythonModuleDispatchesItsSkills(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	asset, ok := mustEmbeddedCatalog(t).Module("python")
+	if !ok {
+		t.Fatal("missing Python module")
+	}
+	var module struct {
+		RequiredSkills []string `json:"requiredSkills"`
+		SkillDispatch  []struct {
+			Skill    string `json:"skill"`
+			Triggers []struct {
+				ID   string `json:"id"`
+				When string `json:"when"`
+			} `json:"triggers"`
+		} `json:"skillDispatch"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(asset.Data, &module); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	want := []string{"uv", "ruff", "ty", "pytest", "python-services", "typer", "fastapi", "python-file-pipelines", "developing-with-streamlit"}
+	if !slices.Equal(module.RequiredSkills, want) {
+		t.Fatalf("required skills = %v, want %v", module.RequiredSkills, want)
+	}
+	if len(module.SkillDispatch) != len(want) {
+		t.Fatalf("dispatch count = %d, want %d", len(module.SkillDispatch), len(want))
+	}
+	conditional := []string{"typer", "fastapi", "python-file-pipelines", "developing-with-streamlit"}
+	for index, dispatch := range module.SkillDispatch {
+		if dispatch.Skill != want[index] {
+			t.Errorf("dispatch %d = %q, want %q", index, dispatch.Skill, want[index])
+		}
+		if len(dispatch.Triggers) != 1 {
+			t.Errorf("%s has %d triggers, want one", dispatch.Skill, len(dispatch.Triggers))
+			continue
+		}
+		trigger := dispatch.Triggers[0]
+		if trigger.ID != "trigger.python."+dispatch.Skill {
+			t.Errorf("%s trigger ID = %q", dispatch.Skill, trigger.ID)
+		}
+		if got, want := strings.HasPrefix(trigger.When, "Only when the repository"), slices.Contains(conditional, dispatch.Skill); got != want {
+			t.Errorf("%s conditional = %t, want %t: %s", dispatch.Skill, got, want, trigger.When)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestThePythonProfileRendersThePythonGuide(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+	outcome, err := BuildPlan(context.Background(), PlanRequest{
+		Repository: newPlanRepository(t), ProfileID: "python", Decisions: planTestDecisions(),
+		Preservation: RootPreservationRequest{Mode: PreservationModeGreenfield},
+	})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if outcome.Plan == nil || outcome.Result.State != "ready" {
+		t.Fatalf("Python outcome = %+v, want ready plan", outcome.Result)
+	}
+	guide := strings.Join(strings.Fields(string(planPostimage(t, *outcome.Plan, "docs/agents/python.md").Content)), " ")
+	want := []string{
+		"These rules govern the repository's Python project: its package, its entry points and its tests, managed with uv. Code in another language follows its own guide.",
+		"- **mandatory**: Change dependencies only through uv: `uv add`, `uv add --group dev`, `uv remove` and `uv lock --upgrade-package`. Commit `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock` together, and never install into the project environment with `pip`.",
+		"- **mandatory**: Run Python, pytest, ruff and every other project tool through `uv run`, so each uses the locked project environment and the Python version the project pins, never a globally installed interpreter or tool.",
+		"- **mandatory**: Create a worktree's or CI job's environment with `uv sync --frozen` and the development group the gate needs, so it installs exactly what `uv.lock` records; a step that must also refuse a lockfile that no longer matches `pyproject.toml` uses `--locked` instead.",
+		"- **mandatory**: The repository Verification checks the lockfile with `uv lock --check --offline`: it compares `uv.lock` with `pyproject.toml` from local files alone, fails when they no longer match, and needs no network or cache, so it runs inside a Run as in CI.",
+		"- **mandatory**: Use focused commands such as `uv run pytest <node id>`, `uv run ruff check <path>` and `uv run ty check <path>` while iterating, then run the selected repository Verification.",
+		"- **prohibited**: Do not hide a ruff finding: never pass `--exit-zero`, add a blanket `# noqa`, or widen the ruff configuration to make a finding disappear. A `# noqa` names the rule code it silences and the reason.",
+		"- **mandatory**: The repository Verification type-checks the package and its tests with `uv run ty check --error-on-warning`, ty being a development dependency. Do not hide a ty diagnostic: never pass `--exit-zero` or `--exit-zero-on-warning`, add a blanket `# ty: ignore` or `# type: ignore`, or widen the ty configuration to make a diagnostic disappear. A suppression names the rule it silences and the reason.",
+		"- **mandatory**: A Task Verification selects a new test by its pytest node id, such as `tests/test_report.py::test_totals`, and never passes that test's file or directory in the same command. pytest collects a node id once when another argument already contains it and exits 0 even before the test exists, so the command could never fail before the work; a missing node id alone exits 4 and an empty selection exits 5. `roundfix spec check` reports a command that names a test both ways.",
+		"- **mandatory**: Keep tests hermetic: set or clear with `monkeypatch` every environment variable the code under test reads, write only under `tmp_path`, and never read the host's credentials, home directory, network or tool state.",
+		"- **mandatory**: A test that needs data from outside the repository, such as a mounted drive or a credentialed service, calls `pytest.skip` with a reason that names the environment variable or path it lacks, so the selected Verification passes on a machine without that data. A Task Verification never depends on such a test.",
+		"- **mandatory**: When a change touches code that branches on the operating system, such as on `sys.platform`, `os.name` or `platform.system()`, exercise every branch it names: test each one with `monkeypatch` over the value the code reads, or run `uv run ty check --python-platform <platform>` for each platform it names, because a test run on the host executes only the host's branch.",
+		"- **mandatory**: Keep each entry point thin, whether a console script, a web application factory or a worker's start-up: it reads its input and calls behavior that lives in the package. Test behavior through the package and the entry point's observable contract: for a console script, standard output, standard error and the exit code it raises with `SystemExit`; for a web application or a worker, the responses or messages it produces.",
+	}
+	for _, text := range want {
+		if !strings.Contains(guide, strings.Join(strings.Fields(text), " ")) {
+			t.Errorf("Python guide lacks %q", text)
+		}
+	}
+	dispatch := string(planPostimage(t, *outcome.Plan, "docs/agents/skill-dispatch.md").Content)
+	for _, skill := range []string{"uv", "ruff", "ty", "pytest", "python-services", "typer", "fastapi", "python-file-pipelines", "developing-with-streamlit"} {
+		if !strings.Contains(dispatch, "`"+skill+"`") {
+			t.Errorf("dispatch guide lacks %s", skill)
+		}
+	}
+	root := string(planPostimage(t, *outcome.Plan, "AGENTS.md").Content)
+	if !strings.Contains(root, "Python implementation rules are mandatory: `docs/agents/python.md`") {
+		t.Errorf("root lacks Python guide pointer: %s", root)
+	}
+	for _, postimage := range outcome.Plan.Postimages {
+		if slices.Contains([]string{"docs/agents/go.md", "docs/agents/rust.md", "docs/agents/tui.md", "docs/agents/cli.md"}, postimage.Path) {
+			t.Errorf("python plan renders %s", postimage.Path)
+		}
+	}
+}
diff --git a/internal/baseline/python_setup_test.go b/internal/baseline/python_setup_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..f15165a2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/baseline/python_setup_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,139 @@
+// Suite: published Python Setup Snapshot
+// Invariant: Python mirrors the curated upstream preset and shares every upstream skill revision with the other snapshots.
+// Boundary IN: embedded setup provenance, ordered skill membership, and upstream revisions.
+// Boundary OUT: profile composition, asset synchronization, and skill installation.
+
+package baseline
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"reflect"
+	"slices"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+const pythonPresetRevision = "65d5f365cace27c4b468db1723213723b10c870b"
+
+func TestThePythonSetupIsThePublishedUpstreamPreset(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	catalog, err := LoadEmbeddedCatalog()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	entry, ok := catalog.Setup("python")
+	if !ok {
+		t.Fatal("embedded Python Setup Snapshot is missing")
+	}
+	var setup assetsSyncSnapshot
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(entry.Data, &setup); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	wantSource := assetsSyncSource{
+		Type: "github", Repository: "marcioaltoe/skills",
+		Ref: pythonPresetRevision, Path: "setups/python.txt",
+	}
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(setup.Source, wantSource) {
+		t.Errorf("Python setup source = %+v, want %+v", setup.Source, wantSource)
+	}
+	wantNames := []string{
+		"find-skills",
+		"knowledge-workspace",
+		"setup-context-driven",
+		"brainstorming",
+		"business-analyst",
+		"context7-cli",
+		"exa-web-search",
+		"grill-with-docs",
+		"grilling",
+		"write-idea",
+		"write-prd",
+		"agentic-cli-design",
+		"domain-modeling",
+		"write-techspec",
+		"write-tasks",
+		"coding-guidelines",
+		"implement-spec",
+		"implement-task",
+		"no-workarounds",
+		"testing-boss",
+		"typesafe-ai",
+		"evidence-gate",
+		"qa-gate",
+		"systematic-debugging",
+		"roundfix",
+		"archive-spec",
+		"conventional-commits",
+		"crafting-effective-readmes",
+		"github-pr-workflow",
+		"ai-memory-durable-pages",
+		"ai-memory-handoff",
+		"ai-memory-learning-maintenance",
+		"ai-memory-messaging",
+		"ai-memory-retrieval",
+		"ai-memory-routing-install",
+		"tech-writer",
+		"uv",
+		"ruff",
+		"ty",
+		"pytest",
+		"typer",
+		"fastapi",
+		"python-services",
+		"python-file-pipelines",
+		"backend-docs",
+		"external-api-adapters",
+		"integration-contract-testing",
+		"security-best-practices",
+		"pdf",
+		"pdftk-server",
+		"docker",
+		"developing-with-streamlit",
+	}
+	var gotNames []string
+	for _, skill := range setup.Skills {
+		gotNames = append(gotNames, skill.Name)
+	}
+	if !slices.Equal(gotNames, wantNames) {
+		t.Errorf("Python setup skills = %v, want ordered preset %v", gotNames, wantNames)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestEveryUpstreamSetupFollowsThePythonPresetRevision(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	catalog, err := LoadEmbeddedCatalog()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, id := range []string{"go", "rust", "typescript", "python"} {
+		t.Run(id, func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+
+			entry, ok := catalog.Setup(id)
+			if !ok {
+				t.Fatalf("embedded setup %q is missing", id)
+			}
+			var setup assetsSyncSnapshot
+			if err := json.Unmarshal(entry.Data, &setup); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if setup.Source.Ref != pythonPresetRevision {
+				t.Errorf("setup %s revision = %q, want %q", id, setup.Source.Ref, pythonPresetRevision)
+			}
+			var hasMemoryHandoff bool
+			for _, skill := range setup.Skills {
+				if skill.Source.Type == "github" && skill.Source.Ref != pythonPresetRevision {
+					t.Errorf("setup %s skill %s revision = %q, want %q", id, skill.Name, skill.Source.Ref, pythonPresetRevision)
+				}
+				if id == "python" && skill.Name == "handoff" {
+					t.Error("Python setup still contains the retired handoff skill")
+				}
+				hasMemoryHandoff = hasMemoryHandoff || skill.Name == "ai-memory-handoff"
+			}
+			if id == "python" && !hasMemoryHandoff {
+				t.Error("Python setup lacks ai-memory-handoff")
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
